notes.title: Lost Beyond - Forest Freeroam Content Update
notes.notes:
Lost Beyond Forest Freeroam Update

What's new?


Game Functionalities


- We have decided to Split the Forest Freeroam into 2 subcategories.


 Upon selection of Forest Freeroam, now you will be able to choose whether you want to play with or without any threats or dangers. 

 Freeroam Survival 
This Selection of Freroam will include all the newly added Content. Various Survival Elements like Hunger, Thirst, Health, Crafting, Player and Weapon Inventory, Fighting, Huntable Animals and Dangerous Animals, and many more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752151/4bf7ee282332085b0f6ccef41754a961d43ac735.png

 Freeroam Zen 
This Selection of Freeroam will not include Survival Elements like Hunger, Thirst, Health, Crafting etc. nor  dangerous Animals and Creatures. You will still be able to access Building Menu.
   Note: This Mode will include all additions to the Map and other non-dangerous components.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752151/b346906cdcd7e7e9bef6232f26668165bf5f682f.png

Map Enhancements

We are also bringing lots of updates to the World itself. 


 Completely new Lake Systems, which not also look different, but are interactable and have complete underwater world. 
 New varieties of trees, and more visual detail across the whole Map.
 Territorial areas across the Map. There are areas where different creatures can be found. 
 Over 10,000 Collectable Resources across the Map. This includes Crafting Resources and Consumable Items like Fruits 
 Caves around the map where you can find rare resources like Metal, or Special Items.




Player Enhancements

There are lots of new Improvements for the Player too! (Forest Freeroam Only)


 Toggle between First and Third Person View. 
 Improved Animations.
 Swimming and Diving - Player can now Dive and Explore the underwater world.
 Fighting Stance - Player now has a new Animation System when attacking and Fighting.



Other

Other Additions include Minimap, Redesigned UI and more!

Note: We were having issues with the new Save System and it did not make it into this update without delaying further. It will be up and running with the upcoming patch fix! You can expect this update in the coming days. You can still save your buildings by pressing 0 (zero).


We truly hope you will enjoy the new content, and stay tuned for all upcoming changes. 

Have fun playing!
D4RKK1TE Team

notes.title: Forest Freeroam Upcoming Content Update
notes.notes:
Lost Beyond - Forest Freeroam Update
Jan. 17th, we will be launching a brand new and awaited update for Forest Freeroam. 


This Update will include dozen new features, player improvements including Weapons, Inventory, Survival Stats and Crafting, Swimming and Diving System, Improved Animations and many more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752151/8741d1419fec61b3d1bc288c2892f6605cf80ab9.png

We're also bringing lots of additions to the Map, with Huntable Animals and Dangerous Animals. Over 10,000 collectable resources including crafting materials and various consumable items like fruits. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752151/d1f3097359e30765f1cc05c4ca3f3b4269731162.png

Completely replaced and improved Lake System with ability to dive and Explore the Underwater World!

There is also addition of a Minimap which is optional to activate, as well as a new Save System accessible from In-Game menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752151/ace1ed250e7a9880139537e2cb54a323dc24b611.png


Freeroam Zen

Freeroam Zen will be a Subcategory of Forest Freeroam. Exact same world only without Survival Elements like Hunger and Thirst, Crafting and Dangerous Animals. All other non-dangerous content will be added. This sub-gamemode will be pure Exploration.



Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements. The game is much more stable now, but it still requires a lot of GPU Power if you want to go all out. We will continue to work on this.


Also to add, we have fixed the issues in the Story Mode with this update as well. Brighter Flashlight and Automatic Player Save so you don't lose your progress. There will be no additional content for this Gamemode.

All un-named additions will be posted on Update Event.
This Update is Available Jan. 17th.

See you soon!
D4RKK1TE Team

notes.title: Forest Freeroam Additional Content Update
notes.notes:
This update brings new features to Forest Freeroam Gamemode, as well as performance and bug fixes.  



New Features include:


   Building System allowing you to build your own shelter, or whatever you might imagine.
   Day/Night Cycle
   Inventory System
   Object Destruction with realistic simulation.
   Save System for your progress and creations.


 Coming Monday, Jan. 16th 
      Health, Hunger and Thirst System
      Animals & Creatures (both Prey and Danger)
      Weapons and Player Inventory
      Crafting System (Tools, Food, Various Items)
      Fishing and Interactable objects
      Collectable Resources throughout the World
      Swimming & Diving System

 
And a lot more! 





The In-Game Menu is now controlled by Keyboard Only. (Arrows and Enter)

Tip: If you are experiencing low framerates, allow the game to run a bit until everything is fully loaded and memorised. 




We hope you will enjoy this update and have fun playing! 
D4RKK1TE Team.

notes.title: Lost Beyond Major Update - Forest Freeroam Expansion
notes.notes:
A giant new world. Complete freedom. 


Explore and lose yourself in the most advanced nature system you have seen. Yearly seasons, Day/Night Cylcle and completely dynamic weather to make you immerse even more! 

The Forest Expansion will bring even more interactions and gameplay, with a major update every month, and constant weekly updates for additions, bug fixes, and performance improvements.



Additional notes and features:
 
 
  Procedural nature and environment
  The most advanced weather system
  Vast landscape with no limits and realistic atmosphere
  Building System

      Weapons and Player Inventory
